nodes.title: SG-1 Stop tracking node_modules and dist (fix dist unit tests)
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts already has trackedDistPaths, checkTrackedFiles and untrackNodeModules (which runs git rm -r --cached dist), and the root .gitignore has dist/. The last check found the dist unit tests failing. Desired behaviour: trackedDistPaths and checkTrackedFiles report tracked dist build output, untrackNodeModules also untracks dist, and dist is ignored. Why: repo hygiene, with no source change elsewhere.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a path list, when trackedDistPaths runs, then only paths with a dist directory segment are returned
- Given git ls-files lists game/frontend/dist/index.html, when checkTrackedFiles runs, then that path is reported
- Given the real .gitignore, when isIgnoredByDirRule checks game/frontend/dist/index.html, then it is ignored


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/tests/trackedNodeModules.test.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/tests/assertNoTrackedGuard.test.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/tests/gitignoreCoverage.test.ts
- Out of scope: game/src
- Out of scope: game/frontend/src outside the helper
- Out of scope: backend/
- Preserve: scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts reused, not rewritten
- Preserve: phaser ~3.90.0 pin


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- Reuse npm run untrack:node-modules
- No source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend


## Definition of done
- dist unit tests pass
- npm run typecheck passes in game/ and game/frontend/


## Clarifying questions
- None
